title: Rosetta Layer
description: Some projects I created require multiple database plugins. Thus, I developed a Rosetta API that allows the user to choose their database back end. This works for both server-based and flat-file databases. Essentially, the business layer talks to entities that get piped through a helper class to determine the native implementation required.

meta.projectBoundary: Rosetta is a reusable persistence abstraction that Hydra-Gen uses as SmartDB, but the original record describes use across multiple projects.
